d.seg: Kitne kitne dunga main? Kitne dunga main aapko? 300 rupaye dunga, 400 rupaye dunga, 500 rupaye dunga
d.tr: How much will I give? How much will I give you? I will give 300 rupees, 400 rupees, 500 rupees
d.j: The user is explicitly offering money in exchange for a video call service in a suggestive context.

d.seg: 300 rupaye mein aap body dikha rahe ho sabko, theek hai?
d.tr: For 300 rupees you are showing your body to everyone, okay?
d.j: The user is making a suggestive comment regarding the other person's body in exchange for money.
